name: platoon-notes
description: Search and read your Platoon interview notes and transcripts from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Platoon Notes gives ChatGPT read-only access to the interview notes and transcripts in your own Platoon workspace: expert interviews, client meetings and other recorded sessions that Platoon has transcribed and summarized.

What you can do:
- Search across your interviews for a topic and get the matching interviews with deep links into Platoon.
- Read the AI notes of an interview (key summary, full note, Q&A script, timeline) and compare several interviews in one request.
- Quote a transcript window verbatim around a specific moment.
- Browse projects, their tags, documents and questionnaire, and list interviews by date range, type or tag.
- Find which interviewees spoke about a topic or match a name or company.
- See which meeting-bot sessions are scheduled ahead.

Intended users: consultants, researchers and teams who run interviews in Platoon and want to synthesize across them in ChatGPT.

Limitations: the connector only reads data the signed-in user already has access to in Platoon. Nothing is created, changed or deleted through it. It does not upload recordings, schedule interviews or share content. A Platoon account with a verified work email is required; sign in with that account when you connect.
defaultPrompt: Which of my interviews discuss pricing?
Summarize the key takeaways of my latest expert interview.
What did interviewees say about go-to-market risks? Quote the transcript.

positive.description: Search interviews by topic and return deep links
positive.prompt: Which of my interviews discuss pricing?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching interview(s) from the test workspace (the GTM Strategy example interview) with a short matched snippet and a Link URL into app.pltn.ai for each.

positive.description: Read the key-summary notes of one interview
positive.prompt: Give me the key summary of the interview "GTM Strategy for an Enterprise SaaS Platform".
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the interview, then returns its key-summary notes as structured bullet points with block citations like [b12] and a Link URL to the interview.

positive.description: Quote the transcript around a specific moment
positive.prompt: Find where pricing is discussed in the GTM Strategy interview and quote the transcript around that point.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the block id from the search hit to read a transcript window and quotes the speakers verbatim, citing the interview link. It does not return the whole transcript.
Returns the expert-interview type interviews in the test workspace (at least the GTM Strategy example) with date, project and Link URL, and no client-meeting entries.

positive.description: Browse projects and a project's details
positive.prompt: What projects do I have, and what is in my Default project?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's projects with interview counts, then shows the Default project's tags, documents and questionnaire (empty in the test workspace) and its interviews.

negative.description: Unsupported deletion: the connector is read-only
negative.prompt: Delete the Weekly Update interview from my Platoon workspace.

negative.description: Unsupported write: nothing can be created or uploaded
negative.prompt: Upload this recording to Platoon and create a new interview.
Show me the interview notes of another company's Platoon workspace.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search interviews, read AI notes (key summary, full note, Q&A script, timeline), quote transcript windows, browse projects and interviewees, and list upcoming meeting-bot sessions. Read-only; OAuth sign-in with your Platoon account.
